texts: Three people check into a hotel room... where did the missing dollar go? Explain precisely what is wrong with this reasoning.
A store sells apples at 3 for $1 and oranges at 2 for $1. I buy 24 pieces of fruit total and spend exactly $9. How many apples and oranges?
You are an ops agent with tools run_shell/read_file/http_get/send_slack. Intermittent 502s behind nginx. Give the ordered tool calls to diagnose.
A Python batch script suddenly gets OOM-killed at 3am nightly, only in production. Give an ordered diagnostic checklist cheapest-first.
My dad passed away three weeks ago. We hadn't spoken in two years after a bad fight. I keep swinging between grief and anger. I just needed to say it to someone.
My best friend got the promotion I was passed over for and wants to celebrate tonight. I'm happy for her and I kind of hate her and I hate that I feel that way. What do I do?
What is 17 * 23? Show the arithmetic.
A bat and a ball cost $1.10 in total. The bat costs $1.00 more than the ball. How much does the ball cost? Explain why the intuitive answer is wrong.
You are an ops agent with tools kubectl/dig/curl/read_file. A pod cannot resolve external DNS names but cluster-internal service names work. Give the ordered tool calls to diagnose.

You are an ops agent with tools run_shell/read_file/http_get/send_slack. After a rolling deploy, OAuth token refresh intermittently returns 401 for ~2% of users, only on one AZ. Give the ordered tool calls to isolate the cause before rollback.
I just found out I didn't get into the grad program I spent two years preparing for. Everyone keeps saying it happens for a reason and honestly that makes me furious.
My partner and I keep having the same fight about money and I'm starting to dread coming home. I don't even know what I'm asking, I just feel stuck.
You are an ops agent with tools kubectl/read_file/run_shell. A deployment rollout is stuck at 2/5 replicas ready. Give the ordered tool calls to find out why.
With tools http_get/run_shell/send_slack, investigate why the /healthz endpoint alternates between 200 and 503 under load. Give the ordered calls.
You have tools dig/curl/read_file. TLS handshake failures spiked right after a certificate rotation. Give the ordered diagnostic tool calls.
A train leaves at 3:40pm averaging 80 km/h and another at 4:10pm averaging 100 km/h on the same route. When does the second catch the first? Show your work.
A rope ladder hangs over a ship's side with rungs 30 cm apart. The tide rises 90 cm. How many rungs go underwater? Explain the trick in the question.
Three boxes are labeled apples, oranges, and mixed — every label is wrong. You may draw one fruit from one box. Explain how to relabel all three correctly.
I've been the caregiver for my mom for three years and yesterday I screamed at her over nothing. I can't stop replaying it.
My manager praised my teammate in front of everyone for work that was mostly mine, and I just smiled. It's been eating at me all week.
We put our dog down on Saturday. The house is so quiet now and I keep listening for her.
